entries.description: Two palms joined in prayer position at chest height with slight bow.
Right open hand raised to temple and waving outward.
Open arms sweeping gently inward toward chest.
Flat open hand touching chin/lips then moving gracefully forward.
Flat palm rubbing in circular clockwise motion on chest center.
Closed fist rubbing in circular motion over heart/chest.
Thumbs-up for GOOD followed by arm rising like the morning sun.
Hand raised overhead indicating sun at midday.
Dominant hand descending softly over horizontal non-dominant forearm.
Palms together tilting gently beside cheek with slight head tilt.
Index finger pointing directly at one's own chest center.
Index finger pointing directly forward toward conversational partner.
Index finger sweeping in a semicircle from right shoulder to left shoulder.
Index finger pointing slightly to the side and sweeping outward.
Open 5-finger hand with thumb tapping gently on the chin.
Open 5-finger hand with thumb tapping gently on the forehead.
Fists rubbing gently together in front of chest.
Index finger touching nose side then bringing hands together.
Both hands clasping/shaking warmly in front of chest.
Both hands forming a circle in front of torso.
Both arms cradled together rocking gently side to side.
Both flat hands moving parallel downward along torso sides.
Fist positioned at shoulder height nodding up and down from the wrist.
Index and middle fingers snapping against thumb with head shake.
Both open palms facing up, moving slightly side to side in inquiry.
Index finger upright wagging side to side with raised eyebrows.
Index fingers circling each other then touching tips.
Fingers touching temple then opening outward into questioning palm.
Index finger circling gently near chin/mouth.
Curved hands backs together rolling upward to open palms.
Both thumbs-up hands alternating up and down like a balance scale.
Fingers bunched upward then opening into spread 5-finger hands.
Flattened O hands at sides of forehead moving outward, then person marker.
Right hand scooping knowledge from open left palm to forehead.
C-shaped hands outlining class circle in front of torso.
Both flat palms clapping gently twice in front of chest.
Two palms pressed together opening outward like a book.
Two fingers of right hand scanning across open left palm.
Pinched right fingers miming writing across flat left palm.
Picking up information from open left palm and placing at forehead.
Index finger flicking upright from fist beside temple like an idea bulb.
Index finger drawing a question mark in the air.
Dominant hand with thumbs-up resting on flat open non-dominant palm, lifting upward.
Three middle fingers upright forming 'W', tapping near chin/mouth.
Fingertips bunched together tapping lips twice.
Hand forming letter T gently shaking side to side.
Two fingers drawing a cross on the upper left arm.
Right fingers touching inner left wrist as if checking pulse.
Middle finger grinding in a small circle on open left palm.
Both index fingers pointing at each other and jabbing inward twice.
Both flat hands touching fingertips at an angle to form a house roof.
Thumb rubbing across index and middle fingertips.
Clear thumbs-up gesture held firmly at chest level with confident head nod.
Thumbs-down gesture or hand flipped downward with head shake.
Open palms brushing upward repeatedly on chest with bright expression.
Open 5-finger hands sliding slowly down the face with bowed head.
Curved claw hand rising tensely in front of chest/face.
Both open hands raised defensively in front of chest trembling slightly.
Both arms crossed warmly over the heart/chest.
Both hands touching chest then dropping downward with relaxed shoulders.
Vertical open dominant hand slicing down onto flat horizontal palm.
Dominant hand beckoning inward toward the chest.
Index finger or open hand sweeping forward away from body.
Two fingers of right hand hooking downward onto two fingers of left hand.
Two V-fingers standing upright on flat open left palm.
Both palms facing up with fingers wiggling gently.
Right fist tapping twice on the back of left fist.
Both hands with thumb and pinky extended twisting cheerfully.
Right index finger tapping twice on the back of the left wrist.
Both index fingers pointing straight down in front of body.
Thumb touching cheek then arcing forward.
Thumb touching cheek then arcing backward toward shoulder.
Index and middle fingers of both hands tapping crosswise in front of chest.
Thumb and pinky extended held beside ear and mouth like a telephone.
